quick_skim.title: Diffusion Flow Matching: Dimension-Improved KL Bounds and Wasserstein Guarantees
quick_skim.abstract: Diffusion Flow Matching (DFM) has recently emerged as a versatile framework for generative modeling, yet its theoretical convergence properties remain only partially understood. In this work, we provide refined and novel convergence guarantees for Brownian motion based DFMs, focusing on the discretization error. Our analysis is conducted under the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and the 2-Wasserstein distance. Under finite-moment conditions and a mild score integrability assumption, we derive KL convergence bounds with improved dimensional dependence compared to prior work, achieving, up to our knowledge, state-of-the-art scaling under minimal conditions. We further extend the analysis to the 2-Wasserstein distance: under an additional first-order score integrability assumption and a weak log-concavity condition, we obtain convergence guarantees with dimensional dependence consistent with the KL case.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Theoretical convergence guarantees for diffusion flow matching with improved KL bounds and Wasserstein distances, providing foundational support for flow matching methods that can be applied to fluid dynamics.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 本文针对布朗运动驱动的扩散流匹配模型，在KL散度和2-Wasserstein距离下给出了改进的离散化误差上界，首次在较弱的矩条件和评分可积性假设下达到最优维度依赖。这些理论保证为流匹配方法在流体动力学（如湍流生成）中的应用奠定了坚实基础，即便论文本身未涉及流体应用，其分析框架可直接迁移至流体相关任务。

quick_skim.title: Perron--Frobenius Operator Matching for Generative Modeling
quick_skim.abstract: We introduce Perron--Frobenius Operator Matching (PFOM), a generative framework that matches density evolution via the integral PF operator, subsuming flow, diffusion, and jump models. We prove that among Bregman divergences, only Kullback--Leibler divergence preserves equality between density-level and sample-conditioned objectives, yielding a practical loss equivalent to Koopman path matching. We further develop Nesterov-accelerated training and sampling that stabilize discretization and accelerate convergence. %On Gaussian mixtures and two-moons, PFOM achieves faster KL/$W_2$/MMD decrease and improved wall-clock efficiency with empirical validation. PFOM unifies operator-theoretic identification with modern generative modeling and opens paths to adaptive dictionaries and high-dimensional applications.

quick_skim.title: Stochastic Thermodynamics and SDE-based Generative Models
quick_skim.abstract: SDE-based generative models, including diffusion models and the Schrödinger bridge, have found broad applications in signal processing tasks such as speech enhancement, image restoration, and time-series generation. This note presents a modeling framework for such models within the context of stochastic thermodynamics. The main results of this note are trajectory-level definitions of work, heat, and entropy production, along with a generalized Jarzynski identity and a second-law-like inequality. The proposed framework extends the original Jarzynski setup to accommodate time-dependent bath temperature and nonconservative driving forces. This thermodynamic perspective may deepen our understanding of diffusion models and the Schrödinger bridge from a nonequilibrium statistical mechanics viewpoint.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This note provides a thermodynamic framework for SDE-based generative models (diffusion and Schrodinger bridge), extending Jarzynski equality and second law to time-dependent settings.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 本文为基于SDE的生成模型（扩散模型和薛定谔桥）建立了热力学框架，定义了轨迹层面的功、热和熵产生，并推广了Jarzynski恒等式和第二类不等式。该框架适用于时变浴温度和非保守驱动力，为扩散模型在计算流体力学中的理论理解提供了新视角。尽管未直接应用流体，但其理论工具可启发流体流动模拟中扩散模型的设计与分析。
